meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 装此技能后，Claude 能无头启动引擎应用，模拟键盘鼠标输入并逐帧录像，最后生成含时间线、检查项的视频汇总页并打开它。
howto.when: 当需要无头验证引擎应用，或要求录制验证过程并生成汇总页时。

say.text: 帮我写一个 verify 脚本，驱动 typing 应用并录制验证
say.note: 输出视频和 summary 页面

say.text: 验证 demo 应用，执行点击和滚轮后检查帧数
say.note: 在汇总页显示检查结果

say.text: 用 verify 录制一次完整验证，结束时打开汇总页

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can launch the engine app in a pty, simulate keyboard/mouse input, record every frame, then generate a video summary page with timeline and checks and open it.
howto.when_en: When headless verification of an engine app is needed, or when the user asks to record a verification run and produce a summary page.

say_en.text: Write a verify script to drive the typing app and record the run
say_en.note: It will output a video and summary page.

say_en.text: Verify the demo app, click and scroll, then check frame count
say_en.note: Checks appear on the summary page.

say_en.text: Use verify to record a full verification and open the summary when done
